preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of Time Corridors m must be between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, _ in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for _, _, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each corridor must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain m - (n - 1) lines, each representing the E_max value for a non-MST corridor.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(e_max, int) and 0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output)
postconditions.description: Each E_max value in the output must be an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max == max(e for a, b, e in corridors if (a, b) != (u, v) and (b, a) != (u, v)) for e_max, (u, v, _) in zip(output, non_mst_corridors))
postconditions.description: Each E_max value must be the maximum energy requirement of the MST excluding the corresponding non-MST corridor.
